dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Wow, this brings back memories! No matter how much time passes, this warm atmosphere always puts me at ease...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Ah, I really miss the taste of Poissonchant Pie. Why don't you head inside and take a seat? I'll prepare the ingredients, and we'll be eating in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Remember to crouch a little when you go inside. I don't want you to bump your head.
